response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack development skills and a broad technical background, but his experience with C++ and industrial automation is limited compared to the role's requirements. His open-source contributions and diverse project history show adaptability, but the role demands deeper expertise in C++, secure coding, and industrial cybersecurity standards.
strengths: Extensive experience with full-stack development, including modern languages and frameworks (TypeScript, Node.js, React).
Proven track record in building scalable, event-driven systems and open-source platforms (e.g., GISCollective).
Strong problem-solving skills and mentorship experience, with a focus on testable, high-quality code.
concerns: Limited recent hands-on experience with C++ (last noted in 2015 at National Instruments).
No explicit mention of industrial automation, IoT protocols, or IEC 62443 cybersecurity standards.
Most roles emphasize web/mobile development, which may not align with the role's focus on high-performance C++ and embedded systems.
